'''''Bultz''''' was a group of two [[Delta-class DX-9 stormtrooper transport|stormtrooper transports]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The transports attempted to fight back against an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] attack consisting of [[TIE/IN interceptor/Legends|TIE Interceptors]] and [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] on a supply depot, which included [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] ''[[Revt]]'', [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] but were destroyed in the battle along with the space depot, including a [[Container transport]] [[Moth (Container transport)|''Moth'']]. The battle was recorded and adapted into the [[Combat chamber]] to train future [[TIE pilot|pilots]], one of which was [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]].
